reviews.author: Shantae Maxey
reviews.text: We have been taking all of our vehicles to Choice Tire and Automotive for years. They are honest, friendly and have the best prices around. This family owned and operated company goes above and beyond and makes you feel like family when you are there. Eric and his crew are top-notch. We highly recommend this company!

reviews.author: Lori Applegate
reviews.text: Customer service is always excellent, the turnaround time is quick, and the pricing is always better than expected. Eric, Lane, and the entire crew are professional, knowledgeable, and very friendly. They stay busy but still make every customer feel like a priority and take the time to make sure everything is done right. I especially appreciated the follow-up call from a team member after the car was done, thanking us for our business. I highly recommend Choice Tire and Automotive and will definitely be back!

reviews.author: John Flaherty
reviews.text: I’ve been here two times. First time I needed new rear brakes and they got them replaced fast! Second time I had issues with a sound coming from my car, I thought it was my axles and they checked it and didn’t find any issues with them. Turns out it’s a plastic piece that makes a noise that it is a design flaw on my car. (Found that out later from a person who works on my car brand) I bring that up because Choice could have lied and charged me and I wouldn’t have known any different. They were not only honest but they didn’t even charge me an inspection fee. These guys are good people and will definitely go here again.

reviews.author: Lorena Ruiz
reviews.text: I recently brought my Jeep in for tire mounting, balancing, and an alignment. After the service, I experienced a flapping noise from the rear and noticed the vehicle pulling to the left. When I returned to address the issue, one staff member at the front desk I believe name was Randy, was dismissive when I explained my concerns and tried to correct me rather than listen. While the alignment was improved after they rechecked it, my question about the cause of the flapping noise was not clearly answered. Instead, I was spoken about in front of me, which felt unprofessional. I do want to acknowledge that another employee was helpful and courteous, and the vehicle does drive better now. However, the lack of clear communication and the dismissive attitude made the experience frustrating. I hope the shop can improve customer communication and ensure concerns are addressed respectfully.

reviews.author: michael baker
reviews.text: Eric, Lane, and the entire team at Choice made me feel like family. After visiting several shops in Kernersville that either couldn’t help or made things overly complicated and expensive, Choice was a breath of fresh air. From the moment I arrived, Lane and Eric went out of their way to explain the process, make it simple, and get the job done quickly and professionally. What others made seem difficult, they handled with ease. I truly appreciate the honesty, care, and great service, I only wish I had come here first. From now on, it’s Choice Tire for me.

reviews.author: Kayla Matthews
reviews.text: Have worked with Choice twice now. They are always quick to answer and very friendly! Love that you feel like family when you are there. Honest and welcoming, not many shops left like this!

reviews.author: Mark Hill
reviews.text: Great experience, they were able to work me in for a front end alignment and was out in a short time.

reviews.author: Jay Moore
reviews.text: This was my first time using Choice Tire and I couldn’t be happier. They are hands down the best place for tires in the Triad. Their prices beat everyone else, not even Costco could compete. On top of that, the team here is fantastic. A lot of the employees came from Taylor Tire so you’ll likely recognize some familiar faces. They’re friendly, knowledgeable, and make the whole process easy. Great prices, great people, and great service. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Jamie Curry
reviews.text: Could not be happier. I do most of my own work on my cars but when something came up that was beyond me I started the search. David was amazing, he beat every price I had gotten and they got me in and out so much faster than any other estimate had said. This is a no nonsense place that was more concerned about bringing more business than trying to gouge someone which happens all too often especially on expensive jobs. Very thankful and will definitely be back and recommending to others.

reviews.author: George Sloyer II
reviews.text: I have been using the friendly people at Choice since they opened this location. Great value for tires and dependable fair prices on repairs and diagnostics. BUT what made me post was an example of OUTSTANDING customer service; it is HOT out and I took my truck in for new tires. With the spare on the ground and a daily rim in the truck bed. Not only did they mount the right tires and put them all on the truck, but they went the extra step without being asked of putting the spare back up under the truck in the storage spot. . . .that is "anticipating the need" and going the extra step. Thank you fellas. I will be back again. Keep up the good work

reviews.author: Nadine Kiser
reviews.text: First time using Choice Tire and Automotive Kernersville and was very pleased with the service... My car was towed there and they were able to get the issue fixed the next morning after being extremely busy that day. David and staff were true to their word each time we spoke and got us back on the road in no time...Very professional and would recommend them and I will definitely use them in the future..

reviews.author: Kim Plum
reviews.text: Today was my first time using Choice after looking at many reviews on shops and tires. Great prices, great service and I was in and out in 2 hours. I’ll definitely be back for my next oil change.

reviews.author: Charlie Turner
reviews.text: Went to Choice Tire after going to their competitor 2 days after having a new tire installed. Thankfully they tightened just the right part so my tire isn't leaking air now! Very Grateful! Thank You Choice Tire and Automotive!

reviews.author: Jamye Whitt
reviews.text: I’ve always trusted this place. I’ve taken my Audi S5 here and now my Toyota RAV4. My father bought me tires for Christmas and Choice automotive and tire got them on, balanced, and aligned on December 26th in record time! I love this place They really treat you like family. I’ll be back when my oil change is due!

reviews.author: Roger LaDue
reviews.text: I had a slow leak in my tire at 4:30 Tuesday afternoon. I stopped in to see if there was anything they could do for me. A young man dropped everything and fixed my tire even though I have never been a customer there. Everyone there was very friendly and I will definitely be looking to them when I need tires.

reviews.author: Alex Smith
reviews.text: I would highly recommend Choice Tire and Automotive to anyone in the area! These guys are prompt, professional and courteous. I was highly impressed with the knowledge and care they had for my vehicle. Brandon, Eric and the staff have always been personable and given the best advice/options that fulfill my needs and budget. This family owned and operated company goes above and beyond to satisfy the needs and concerns of customers time and time again. Your money will be well spent at this establishment. 5 Stars all around, Thanks Choice!

reviews.author: Emily Farrell
reviews.text: 7/23/2025 update: had a flat tire this morning, but I didn't worry because we bought the tires at Choice. They were able to patch the hole from the screw I ran over. I was back on the road in less than an hour! Thankful!! 4/9/2025 update: Choice Tire's team is excellent! I am thankful for their integrity and care! I send everyone I can to Choice Tire because of the quality of their work and dedication to doing what is right! Thank you, Choice Tire! Wow! I have always been intimidated when it comes to car repairs. I am blessed to have a special man in my life who loves all things car! For our anniversary, he surprised me by meticulously picking Choice Tire and Auto to replace my tires. He got a little surprise, too - turns out that the bearings were worn out, so he had those fixed as well. My man doesn't let just anyone work on our cars, but he is confident in the crew at Choice, and now I am, too!

reviews.author: Jenna Pollard
reviews.text: I checked a local group for a place around town and Choice came highly recommended. I called this morning, they said bring it in! My husband got off work and took our car up there bc our tire keeps going flat. They fixed it fast, it was a great price and he said they were really nice. We appreciate great service, it really goes a long way. Keep up the great work guys!

reviews.author: Thomas Horne
reviews.text: I went onsite to get a quote and called a couple weeks later. Of course the times we live everything is going up. This company not only took care of me but made sure I was happy from start to finish. I could NOT have had a better experience!! Don't hesitate to set up tires or anything they offer!! I witnessed a worker *younger guy* be so polite to an older woman rather than like others were it Here's the key now move on! He was also one of 2 who worked on my truck. This is a group of gentlemen who honor quality and respect! The prices are amazing!! I will be back !

reviews.author: Julie DeVaney
reviews.text: Great service. Spent some time assisting me in selecting the right tires. The staff do a good job managing flow of customers smoothly. Able to have my vehicle serviced and set of tires installed at a fair price.

reviews.author: Eric Frohn
reviews.text: Travelling through the area on business. Had a punctured tire. Stopped as they were close but also almost closed. Took me in on moments notice and fixed the tire. Polite and professional! Top notch service. Please support these fine folks! Thanks gentlemen. Much appreciated. Eric

reviews.author: Yolianna Castillo
reviews.text: Great service and an even greater team. TJ immediately started working on my car and I was notified later that day with an update. They did an amazing job of keeping me up-to-date and letting me know all the details for a previous mistake that had occurred at another automotive. TJ was awesome even taking the time to speak to me afterwards about my car after checking out. Really appreciate their service! Check them out!

reviews.author: Roy Rudisill
reviews.text: Took my 97 Chevy truck a few weeks ago For front in alignment, and it was worse after they finished.Then when I brought it. I called back the next day and got no answer. But left message have yet to hear from somebody and my truck is still not good. It just seems like they're way too busy to carry through on their finished job. The guy said something about the front end, but uh, they still charged me a $100 and it made my problem worse. So why did they even charge me if there was something wrong?Since then, I have got everything fixed in the front end. I'm going to reach back out to them, but probably won't get a response.

reviews.author: Bobby Evans
reviews.text: The service is always the best at Choice. I’ll never take my vehicle anywhere else. Best prices, honest people, and they are quick!

reviews.author: Brittany Burleigh
reviews.text: Ordered tires on Wednesday, drop the truck off at 7:30 Friday which was scheduled. Was told they would have the tires no later than 12 and they would be on the truck same day. Go back around 2 tires hadn’t made it yet, swore they would make it and be put on. Call at five as they are open till 7 and still no tires. The part that is ridiculous is no communication. That is where this shop drops the ball. Called corporate and mad a complaint.

reviews.author: Lesa West
reviews.text: Such nice people, family owned and operated. Since Andy's in K'ville changed hands, I needed a reliable, HONEST, car care home, and i didn't want a chain store. I found it here at Choice. They aligned my AWD, assured me I DIDN'T need new tires yet (but gave me exceptional price/quality choices for later, when I do need them), when they could easily have sold me something I really didn't need right now. I highly recommend.

reviews.author: The Ridge Family
reviews.text: This place is top notch and I would highly recommend it to anyone. Eric is super nice, attentive and knowledgeable. I’m sure everyone else there is just as friendly. Their prices are extremely competitive as well. I’m telling you, if you need work done on your vehicle call these guys first. You will not regret it!

reviews.author: Bonnie Longhitano
reviews.text: I wish I could leave more than just five stars. These days it is so hard to get people to treat you with respect as a consumer. I know this goes both ways as well, but when I went in today, I fully expected to be treated the same way I was this past weekend at a different tire shop where I had the worst experience. Not at choice tire. They were respectful, professional, and was old-school when it came to performance. This went along way with me. I am bringing all of my business here and totally recommend them for anything you may need!

reviews.author: Courtney Whitfield
reviews.text: I love this place and these people. I haven’t got anyone’s names but the lady upfront is phenomenal and their alignment guy is freakin fantastic!!! I have brought my jeep and mustang up here twice for alignments and he never seems to fail to make everything right! I’m here now getting tires on a truck and an alignment and I’m sure it’ll be just as good! Highly recommend

reviews.author: Christopher Smith
reviews.text: We take all of our vehicles here for oil changes, tire rotations, new tires, and any mechanical issues we have. We have received excellent care with everything we’ve brought them. Their pricing is reasonable and they do a great job!

reviews.author: Mike Kolb
reviews.text: These guys are the best! Quality service at a great price. They have done a lot of major and minor repairs on my vehicles and every time I have been extremely happy with them! Eric is so great to work with, thanks!

reviews.author: LaVell Avalos
reviews.text: I stopped in initially, just borrow a tool To tighten down a bracket for my Bimini top, they let me the tool no problem, but couldn’t do it and wish I would’ve gotten his name but a really nice gentleman came over with His power tool Just got the job done for me I really appreciate the customer service and just wanted to say thank you.

reviews.author: Gail Lawson
reviews.text: This was the very first time I bought tires (my husband always did this). I am an older lady but Eric not only gave me a good deal but sold me quality tires! For 1 price they not only sold the tires but mounted them. I will also go back for rotations free of charge! Definitely recommend Choice Tire for your needs. Quick and friendly service

reviews.author: Madelyn Walker
reviews.text: Sitting in their office on a Friday writing this review because they BY FAR have provided me and my husband with the most CONSISENT and QUALITY service out of any auto place we have given our business. We will be life long customers!! Side note - I have a 2500 GMC Diesel they take excellent care of every time WITHOUT it being returned to me with new issues and scratches on the body and hood like other places we have taken my diesel before.

reviews.author: Amanda Holt
reviews.text: Took my vehicle to this shop after running over something on the road, my car was shaky and something was very noticeably off. I asked the manager at the desk to please be very thorough and check any and everything that could’ve possibly been affected. Went to pick up my car and upon leaving immediately noticed my car’s steering was still not right and the vehicle was still very shaky. Didn’t trust to take it back there, after seeing as they didn’t help to fix the issue nor were thorough with checking for issues. Took it to another shop to then be told that Choice Tire & Automotive had missed several visible and easily noticeable issues that were a result from me running over something in the road. The second shop informed me quickly that 2 rims were completely bent and 2 tires had broken belts inside and needed to be replaced and I was also informed by the second shop it was unsafe to drive my vehicle with those issues. After learning about this I called to speak with the manager at Choice Tire & Automotive about the damage they didn’t address or inform me about on my vehicle and he immediately denied his shop had made any mistakes and had a very disrespectful tone with me on the phone while continuously interrupting me and cutting me off to make sure and not let me fully explain my concern with the service I received at his shop. I trusted them with my safety and I feel like I was mislead and my concern for my own safety and my vehicle being fixed property was completely disregarded. The only real response to my concern that I was given from the manager was he tried to put blame and talk negatively about the second shop I took my car to, when the second shop is who actually fixed my car and also went more than above and beyond to help with my car.

reviews.author: Alicia Nicole
reviews.text: Choice Tire has always been my go to whenever I need something done to my car. These guys are the best, reliable and honest people to work with if you need something done to your car or even just looked at!! Super easy to work with & accommodating to their customers!!

reviews.author: Rob The PostMan
reviews.text: I love and appreciate the great work and honest staff/mechanics. I will NEVER take any of my vehicles elsewhere. Only Choice Automotive and Tire will be doing any repairs I need done. I HIGHLY recommend you come here for all your Automotive needs!!

reviews.author: Stephanie Smith
reviews.text: Love taking my vehicle here. Always kind and honest. Great oil change prices. Alignments are always perfect. 10/10! Quick.

reviews.author: Stephanie Jacox
reviews.text: Came here for an inspection & not only were they super friendly, but I was in & out in no time!! Definitely a pleasant surprise & I will be back again next time & for others services now too!!

reviews.author: Alicia Johnson
reviews.text: I was able to pop into thier shop at open time and get a full set of new tires for a reasonable price. They were very kind and understanding. I felt overwhelmed and they made my morning smooth and easy.

reviews.author: Steve Hall
reviews.text: Stopped by to see if they could help me with a nail in my tire, had me back it up to a bay, removed the nail, plugged the tire and sent me on my way. Didn't even charge me for it. Now that is some good old home town customer service. This was my first time stopping and it will not be my last, they just earned a customer!!

reviews.author: Terrance Stewart
reviews.text: Amazing service today… called for a quote… great price… arrived at 1130am out by 1215pm with 4 new tires. Thanks for everyone’s assistance!!

reviews.author: Ashley Renée
reviews.text: Absolutely wonderful place to get all of your auto services done. They have worked on several of my family members cars and the prices are very reasonable, and the staff is so sweet. We will definitely come here for all of our automotive needs.

reviews.author: Jared B Pike
reviews.text: Their owner Eric is the most honest person you will ever have the pleasure of doing business with. I’ve know him for over 10 years and I won’t go anywhere else. Treats people right and looks for ways to save you money!

reviews.author: Vicki Lynch
reviews.text: Eric was a good friend of and to my husband. So when I had a problem with a tire sensor naturally I thought of Eric even though I couldn't remember his name. He remembered my husband and was broken hearted when I told him of Frank's passing. He treated me like family. Will I recommend Choice Tire to friends and family. You bet I will. Thanks Eric Vicki Lynch

reviews.author: Lori Sears
reviews.text: Awesome folks, Eric's the best & soooo happy he's back in Kernersville. I drove to Taylors in Greensboro for years just to have Eric oversee my car. Also Scott, owner, is an awesome guy & has integrity as well. Integrity is hard to find these days. I've known Scott since we were kids. 5+ stars!!!!

reviews.author: David Shabat
reviews.text: I drove up from Georgia on business. I stopped by when they were just opening up for the day with a TPMS problem. They put diagnostic computers onto my truck and got me rolling in minutes. And they did it all complimentary. Hats off - take your business to these folks - good people!

reviews.author: Nathan Richardson
reviews.text: This place is awesome. You get that home feeling and they take care of you. The guys out in the shop do it right. They act like they enjoy their job not just being there to get a paycheck. Don't see that much any more. Nathan

reviews.author: Payton Stewart
reviews.text: Had all 4 brake pads and rotors replaced here, kept squealing in reverse. I asked them to check and they said nothings wrong. I took it to another shop and they said the back brake pads needed to be replaced and were very bad. I called to explain the situation and they never called back. I also had to physically show them where a screw was in my tire, they said they only found a rock.

reviews.author: MJM2baseball
reviews.text: They helped me get the best value in tires for what I was looking for. Great service. Will be using them for all my automotive needs.

reviews.author: Christy
reviews.text: Very friendly and honest staff!! I had an inspection and oil change. They didn’t make any unnecessary suggestions such as you need an air filter, wipers, etc. I will definitely be back ~Christy

reviews.author: Brian R
reviews.text: All some took my Chevrolet Silverado 2500 HD truck to them Tuesday morning having a problem with the front end , the technician drove the truck came back to the shop put it on the Lyft found the problem gave me an estimate for repairs coming back on payday so I can get the truck fixed at a great price and I don't have to worry if the job was done right, because of the good professional technicians working at choice auto ... ( THANKS GUYS FOR GREAT WORK )

reviews.author: Simon Shaw
reviews.text: Great service, friendly staff and very accommodating to our request and needs. They have put new tires on my vehicles, performed maintenance, oil changes and inspections. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Shane Foster
reviews.text: A great group of guys that do great work. Very professional and polite. I will definitely keep doing business with choice tire and automotive for years to come.

reviews.author: Brian Ketner
reviews.text: Eric is top notch. They have done me right and got me taken care of Everytime I've been in there. Affordable priced tires as well!

reviews.author: SaveTheQuintons Wilson
reviews.text: Tracy sold me a set of tires in the rain that he claimed had even tread wear. All 4 tires were very choppy. Buyers beware

reviews.author: Mickey Hill
reviews.text: Choice Tire has a great team and very friendly and knowledgeable. They treat you like family instead of just a customer. Great service all around!!!!!

reviews.author: Mike Smith
reviews.text: Great place, super friendly people, David, Eric and Amanda are always super friendly. Prices are unbeatable and they get work done quick.

reviews.author: David Smith
reviews.text: Great customer service - like it was decades ago & low prices with high quality products & service. Love these folks!

reviews.author: Devin Mcintosh
reviews.text: Prices are crazy good. Wonderful service. They got me in and out in a timely manner. Very professional as well

reviews.author: Daniel Wallace
reviews.text: Great service and staff. They were able to work me in on short notice before a road trip, after another place failed me miserably booking my appointment on a day they were closed.

reviews.author: fritz carrier
reviews.text: choice tire and auto are great to do business with. they go the extra mile. eric the manager is by far the best at customer service. they are more than fair!!!!!!

reviews.author: Brandon
reviews.text: Best place in town to go for all your vehicle needs. Extremely friendly staff and fast work at an affordable price.

reviews.author: Dean Harrell
reviews.text: Professional and customer driven. After working 25 years in the car business, this is where I get my cars worked on. Trust is everything!

reviews.author: Javi
reviews.text: Amazing service, honest people they take care of you , anything I need done to my car, the only place I go.

reviews.author: Jacob Porterfield
reviews.text: Scott, Eric and the staff are amazing! They get all our service work for our personal vehicles and our business. Top notch!

reviews.author: Justin Love
reviews.text: I take all of my work vehicles, personal and anyone that asks I send them straight to Choice Automotive for tires, oil change, brakes you name it and Choice can do it! Thanks guys!

reviews.author: Michael Dull
reviews.text: These guys are the best in the business!! Brandon and Eric up front know the tire and wheel business! The mechanics are all good ones!

reviews.author: Connie Bruce
reviews.text: Great shop. Very knowledgeable and reasonably priced. They don't sell you what you don't need. Financing option available too.

reviews.author: c Trader
reviews.text: Fast, Friendly, Competitive, Accommodating, and most importantly Local! Highly recommend. Support this local business. You will not be disappointed.

reviews.author: Tom Twiddy
reviews.text: Best place,best people! Fair prices! Honest also! Can't say enough about this place and the employees!

reviews.author: Christy Gerber
reviews.text: Strictly business, not very personable. Granted, this was my 1st time there. Extremely busy! Cheapest tires out of the 6 places I priced.

reviews.author: Tonya Barkley
reviews.text: Needed to get an inspection. I was able to get in and out with no problems. They do offer some other services

reviews.author: Tammy Roles
reviews.text: Such a great business! I cannot say enough about Choice Automotive. They will always do a great job and give you a fair price.

reviews.author: Brittany Clayton
reviews.text: I have been going to Choice for years because I trusted them to be honest and fair, which is why this experience was so disappointing. On August 6, 2026, I took my car in for new tires. Before the appointment, I was quoted $224 over the phone. I specifically asked if that price included everything and was told yes. When I dropped the car off, I was asked if I wanted the tires balanced and an alignment, and I said yes. At no point was I told that these services would increase the price or given a new total to approve. When I picked up my car, my bill was $363.40, nearly $140 more than the price I had been quoted. What concerned me even more was a call I received while my car was being serviced. I was told that my brakes were worn down to the point of being "metal on metal," that my brakes and rotors needed to be replaced immediately, and that continuing to drive the car was dangerous. I was quoted more than $500 for the repair. I declined because I simply did not have the money available. The very next day, I took my car to another automotive place to get a quote for the brakes. Instead of immediately quoting me, the mechanic inspected the brakes first. After looking at them, he told me they were still in good condition and that I likely had around another year before I should even begin considering replacement. That is an enormous difference between "metal on metal and dangerous to drive" and "you probably have another year." After trusting Choice with my vehicles for years, this seriously damaged my confidence in their recommendations. I was also charged a surcharge for paying with a debit card, which added another frustration to the experience. I understand that additional problems can sometimes be discovered while a vehicle is being serviced, and I have no issue paying for work that is actually needed. My issue is being quoted one price, receiving a substantially higher bill without being clearly informed of the additional cost beforehand, and then being told I urgently needed an expensive safety-related repair that another mechanic inspected the following day and said was nowhere near necessary. Unfortunately, after years of being a customer, I no longer feel that I can trust Choice the way I once did.

reviews.author: Mark Motsinger
reviews.text: I am extremely impressed. The employees are professional, very knowledgeable and provide excellent customer service. They changed all four tires on my truck faster than any shop I have ever been to. Choice Tire and Auto is a locally owned and operated business. If you need new tires, alignment, or just in inspection for your vehicle there is only one Choice. They also offer specialty services like lift kits for trucks as well!
